05474d7458ec9802a644ec0df4f601850e0ab513d5509d0f1a36f461542a61d1:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when introducing trailing editor persistence while preserving synchronous navigation, callback-capable write acceptance, and asynchronous acknowledgements whose UI authority is narrower than their persistence lifetime. TASK states: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save. Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." README.md states: "Accepted writes belong to the document, survive navigation, and all settle."

05474d7458ec9802a644ec0df4f601850e0ab513d5509d0f1a36f461542a61d1:R02 [Event relation]
Use the existing trailing-task utility with a 120 ms quiet interval. Each edit replaces the pending arguments and restarts the deadline; bind those arguments to the accepting document and edit rather than consulting current selection at execution time. Preserve empty text, subsequent bursts, and no-selection editing. src/trailing-task.js contains "pending = args;" and "handle = timers.schedule(flush, delay);". Original src/editor.js contains "if (!current) return;". No additional persistent buffer bank or editor text model is required by these sources.

Establish the newest edit's opaque owner token immediately when accepting the edit, before delayed submission. Preserve exact visit identity as well as latest-edit identity when authorizing status. Original src/editor.js contains "const visit = current, owner = {};" and "visit.latest = owner;". README.md states: "A save-status notification may appear only for the current visit's latest edit.\nA pending newer edit invalidates an older acknowledgement even before its own\nwrite is submitted." src/save-status.js contains "if (event.id === id && accepts(event.owner)) renderStatus(event);". Reopening the same document must not authorize an old visit's acknowledgement.

Consume a pending batch before invoking callback-capable persistence. Preserve src/trailing-task.js ordering: "    handle = null;\n    const args = pending;\n    pending = null;\n    if (args !== null) work(...args);" Nested navigation must not consume the same batch again, and callback-enqueued edits must remain independent pending work. Do not add post-save cleanup that erases or cancels those edits. README.md states: "A newly accepted edit must not be erased by old flush cleanup."

On departure, capture the departing visit, revoke its current ownership, detach its captured status subscription, and flush its pending text exactly once before returning. Flush before reading a replacement document, but do not await acknowledgement. Original src/editor.js contains "const old = current; current = null;" and "if (old) old.stop();". README.md states: "A visit's latest pending text must be submitted exactly once before close or\nnavigation returns; submission must not wait for network acknowledgement." It also states: "Store read exposes the latest accepted draft for immediate reopen; readPersisted\nexposes acknowledged data, protected by write revision against late old writes." Include disposal through src/workspace.js: "dispose() { editor.close(); },".

After departure flushing can invoke a transport start callback, revalidate navigation authority before installing or rendering an open destination or clearing document output for close. Protect clearing effects as well as installation; complete them before callback-capable work or guard them afterward. README.md states: "Navigation priority follows call start order: a newer open/close supersedes an\nouter navigation that resumes after a save-start callback. Obsolete destinations\nmust not render." Cleanup must use captured departing resources so a resumed outer request cannot detach a successor or discard its pending edits.

05474d7458ec9802a644ec0df4f601850e0ab513d5509d0f1a36f461542a61d1:R03 [Preservation]
Preserve independent accepted writes and restrict stale effects at publication rather than cancelling persistence. src/draft-store.js accepts text before transport with "revisions.set(id, revision); accepted.set(id, text);", creates "const event = Object.freeze({ id, text, revision, owner });", and invokes "const pending = transport(event);". Its acknowledgement path uses "if (revision > (committed.get(id) || 0))" before updating persisted data and returns the event. Preserve these revision, Promise, event, and subscription semantics. README.md states: "Do not cancel accepted saves to suppress UI messages." Preserve synchronous editor/workspace interfaces and original document rendering "renderDocument({id, text:store.read(id)});" and close rendering "renderDocument(null);".

05474d7458ec9802a644ec0df4f601850e0ab513d5509d0f1a36f461542a61d1:R04 [Exclusion]
Keep durable editor departure flushing separate from transient preview cancellation. TASK states: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/search-preview.js contains "const task = createTrailingTask(query => publish({ query }), 40, timers);" and "hide() { task.cancel(); },". Preserve its 40 ms delay, discard-on-hide policy, and later reuse. Do not import submission receipts, projection archives, confirmation outlets, persistent buffer banks, or integration-detachment APIs from related experiences when absent from the current public API.

Candidate limitations:
- Attempt 1 reports passing syntax checks and acceptance without behavioral observations. This does not establish causality, exhaustive correctness, or cross-task effectiveness.
- README.md states: "No network failures or
retry policy are included in this fixture; each transport Promise settles once." Exception recovery and retry behavior are unspecified.
- Supported synchronous reentry occurs through transport start callbacks. Reentry from rendering, scheduling, reads, or subscription cleanup is not established.
- Terminal disposal semantics, timer cancellation races, and mutable non-string input behavior are unspecified.
- This revision concerns the supplied asynchronous draft workspace. It does not invalidate projection or submission obligations in the related experiences' original tasks.
- No files were modified and no scorer, reference implementation, or hidden tests were accessed.

05474d7458ec9802a644ec0df4f601850e0ab513d5509d0f1a36f461542a61d1:R05 [Verification]
Use controlled timers and independently resolvable transport Promises to check deadline resetting, no active-burst write before 120 ms of quiet, one latest-text write per burst, subsequent bursts, empty text, and no-selection edits. From both timer-driven and departure-driven transport starts, request nested open, same-document reopen, or close and edit the successor; verify the newest navigation's output survives and successor edits save independently without duplicate consumption. Resolve acknowledgements out of order; verify all settle, persisted data does not roll back, retired visits produce no status, and a pending newer edit suppresses an older acknowledgement before its own submission. Also verify current latest-edit status and unchanged preview timing, hide cancellation, and reuse. These checks derive from TASK and the cited public behavior, not the acceptance verdict.
